params.name: from
params.description: Only return events at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp (inclusive start of the time range). Required together with `to` for a fresh query; omit both when paginating with `cursor`, which resumes the original query and ignores them.

params.name: to
params.description: Only return events at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp (inclusive end of the time range). Required together with `from` for a fresh query; omit both when paginating with `cursor`, which resumes the original query and ignores them.

params.name: resource
params.description: Filter events by the resource type or identifier affected.

params.name: operation
params.description: Filter events by the operation performed.

params.name: actor_id
params.description: Filter events by the actor's NewStore user id (actor.user_id).

params.name: actor_name
params.description: Filter events by a case-insensitive substring of the actor's display name (actor.display_name).

params.name: resource_id
params.description: Filter events by the identifier of the specific resource affected.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination token. Pass the `next_cursor` from a previous response to fetch the next page; omit it to fetch the first page. The other filter parameters must be unchanged across a paged sequence.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of events to return in this page. Defaults to 25; capped at 100. Pagination via `cursor` walks the full result set this many at a time.
